name: Capricorn
baseMeaning: The Capricorn zodiac sign, the sea-goat.
tldr: ♑ identifies a Capricorn birthday or horoscope reference, not a goat ranking or a hidden compliment.

contextMeanings.meaning: ♑ literally names the Capricorn zodiac sign and its sea-goat figure.
contextMeanings.example: my birthday is in january, so i'm a ♑

contextMeanings.meaning: In casual messages, ♑ is shorthand for someone's sign or a horoscope-based personality joke.
contextMeanings.example: the group chat is run by one ♑ and we all know it

contextMeanings.meaning: ♑ can dismiss a horoscope or poke fun at how seriously people take zodiac signs.
contextMeanings.example: apparently my ♑ chart says i need a nap

contextMeanings.meaning: ♑ is clearest when identifying someone's birthday sign in a profile, introduction, or team message.
contextMeanings.example: for the bio, i'm a ♑ born in january

platformNotes.note: ♑ can appear in a bio, birthday post, or caption to identify Capricorn. In a personal profile, the usual meaning is simply the owner's sign.
♑ may accompany a birthday, horoscope, or zodiac-themed video. The surrounding caption determines whether it is literal or part of a joke.
♑ often works as a compact sign label beside a horoscope take or birthday update. Posts focused on astrology may expect more context than the glyph provides.
In family and friend chats, ♑ is a quick way to announce a Capricorn birthday or react to a horoscope. Older recipients may understand the symbol as a zodiac sign even when they rarely use it.

generationalNotes.note: Gen Z users often encounter ♑ through birthday posts, zodiac content, and personal bios. It can read as a quick identity label rather than a serious astrological claim.
Millennials commonly recognize ♑ from horoscope columns and birthday traditions. Depending on the conversation, it may feel like a sign reference, a joke, or both.
Gen X recipients may know Capricorn from print horoscopes without seeing ♑ as part of everyday online language. A plain birthday explanation can prevent confusion.

warnings.title: Mistaking it for the ranking goat
warnings.description: ♑ is a zodiac symbol, while 🐐 is the animal used for top-ranked praise. Use 🐐 when you mean something is the greatest, and send ♑ only when Capricorn or a horoscope is relevant.

warnings.title: Assuming it states a personality fact
warnings.description: Someone mentioning their Capricorn birthday does not necessarily want their traits judged by the sign. Ask about their horoscope or use the sign without making it a claim about them.

seoDescription: What does ♑ mean? It marks Capricorn in birthday messages, bios, and horoscope posts, not the goat-ranking emoji or an automatic compliment.

longForm.overview:
♑ is the Capricorn zodiac symbol, represented by a sea-goat. People at different ages tend to approach it differently: younger users may treat it as a neat label for a birthday or personal profile, while older users may know Capricorn from horoscope columns and read it more literally. The clearest explanation is still the simplest one: it points to the Capricorn sign.

In real conversations, ♑ usually saves someone from spelling out “Capricorn.” It can appear in a birthday message, a bio, a horoscope reaction, or a joke about someone's habits. The glyph does not by itself promise agreement with astrological claims, and it is not another version of the ranking goat emoji.

That distinction matters because the neighboring symbols look related but do different jobs. 🐐 is the goat used in playful rankings, while ♈ is the ram for Aries. ♑ is the older zodiac mark for Capricorn. People sometimes tap or interpret the wrong animal because all three carry a resemblance, so checking the horns and the intended message prevents an odd compliment from becoming confusion.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
♑ appears when a Capricorn birthday is being celebrated, usually beside a name, birth month, or horoscope. “happy birthday, i'm a ♑” is a complete thought, while “my friends call me the office ♑” turns the sign into a casual group-chat joke.

It can also react to a horoscope line without anyone wanting to discuss the whole chart. The sender may be sharing the sign, teasing a friend about it, or pointing out an exaggerated trait. In each case, the surrounding words decide the tone. A Capricorn reference by itself is safe; a claim that the sign explains somebody's personality may need a question or a little humor.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
♑ is a poor fit when you meant the goat used for playful praise, so choose 🐐 for “greatest of all time” reactions. It also does not need to appear in serious family news, formal work updates, or conversations where astrology would distract from the actual subject.

A recipient may know Capricorn as a horoscope sign without knowing the emoji itself, especially across age groups. That is rarely a problem in a warm family chat, but it can look obscure in a workplace introduction or a message intended for a broad audience. Spell out “Capricorn” or include the birth month when clarity matters. If nobody is discussing birthdays or horoscopes, there is usually no reason to send ♑ at all.
longForm.howToReply:
If someone sends ♑, the easiest response is to match its purpose: wish them a happy birthday, ask which part of the horoscope they mean, or identify the sign with “capricorn.” For a playful message, adding your own sign can keep the exchange going without requiring a deep astrology conversation.

If ♑ lands on a joke about your personality, respond lightly rather than treating it as a verdict. Something like “apparently my chart knows me too well” keeps the joke moving. If the person wants a serious horoscope discussion, ask what they make of it. When you are unsure whether they meant Capricorn or the ranking goat, mention both: “you mean ♑, or are you giving the goat award?”

faqs.question: What does ♑ mean from a guy
faqs.answer: It usually means he is a Capricorn, is mentioning a Capricorn birthday, or is making a horoscope joke. Context determines whether it is personal information or just a casual reference.

faqs.question: Is ♑ flirty
faqs.answer: ♑ is not inherently flirty. It becomes flirtatious only when it appears in a romantic message, often as a playful way to mention someone's sign.

faqs.question: What does ♑ mean on TikTok
faqs.answer: On TikTok, ♑ usually identifies Capricorn in a birthday, zodiac video, caption, or joke. The comment or surrounding video may reveal whether the sender is serious or teasing.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ♑ and 🐐?
faqs.answer: ♑ means Capricorn and may refer to a birthday or horoscope. 🐐 is the goat emoji commonly used to call something the best or greatest, so they should not be swapped.

conversationExamples.message: it's my birthday and apparently i'm the only ♑ in this group chat
conversationExamples.interpretation: A Capricorn birthday announcement with a playful dig at the friends. Reply with congratulations or join the teasing by asking whether Capricorns really are the most organized.

conversationExamples.message: you'd have guessed i was a ♑, right
conversationExamples.interpretation: A flirtatious reveal of the sender's zodiac sign. Answer with your own sign or gently tease the stereotype instead of pretending the emoji makes the sign obvious.

conversationExamples.message: for the team bio: i'm a ♑ born in january
conversationExamples.interpretation: A straightforward introduction for a profile or team page. Confirm the birth month or Capricorn label if needed; there is no invitation to analyze the person's work style.

conversationExamples.message: happy birthday to my sister the ♑ ♑
conversationExamples.interpretation: A warm birthday greeting for a Capricorn family member. A birthday wish, a family joke, or both will fit naturally.

conversationExamples.message: my horoscope said a ♑ would cancel plans today and it was too accurate
conversationExamples.interpretation: A light horoscope-based complaint or joke. Respond to the cancelled plans or ask which sign the horoscope claimed would cause them.
